 Date or directions No.
 and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No.1146 of 2023  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. M.S. Pal, Sr. Advocate assisted by Ms. Amreen Bano, Advocate for the applicants.
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. Considering the office report dated 20.06.2025 whereby it is noted that Respondent no.3 has been served secondary through the office, it will amount to consideration that the Respondent no.3 has been duly served.
Since there is no representation on behalf of respondent no.3, the matter shall proceed for final hearing.

4. The present matter relates to an offence under Sections 420, 463, 467 and 468 of IPC whereby the main allegations against the applicants are that in the garb of procuring loan from State Bank of India, Chakarpur, Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar, a security submission of some papers as a mortgaged regarding the property; the said papers that was submitted for the mortgage were alleged to be found forged and also had been previously submitted regarding a mortgage of another loan.

5. Heard Mr. M.S. Pal, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Ms. Amreen Bano, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned AGA for the State.
6.

Though as per noting of this Court that the service regarding the respondent no.3 is served secondary and this is considered to be sufficient and in the interest of justice, a proper representation is to be made on behalf of the State so that the matter may be decided on merits.

7. In the interest of justice, a direction has been issued to the Registry that the concerned Bank be informed so that any representation, if wished, to be made, may be done so, by the next date fixed.

8. List this case on 25.02.2026.
(Ashish Naithani, J.) 05.01.2026 Ravi C482/1146/2023 on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98896939/
